test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Gautam starts from Point A and drives 30 km towards South. He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, turns left and drives 42 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 12 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again?

(All turns are 90 degree turns only unless otherwise specified.)
solution:
Given, 

Gautam starts from Point A and drives 30 km towards South. 

He then takes a left turn, drives 15 km, turns left and drives 42 km. 

He then takes a left turn and drives 7 km. 

He takes a final left turn, drives 12 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31ad69432fbe889392f95f87b23513d3a02921bb17b6f0bee2bb950b331bcfa1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad5acfe9e905df80d047f5c3a633cf66d969f0edd495d6481a1f370cdcff3bb1.png] 

He should drive 8 km in the West direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 4"**
